sens_en: to receive, to put away, to harvest
origine_fr: Le Shuowen jiezi glose 收 par « arrêter, saisir » : 攴, la main qui agit, et 丩 pour le son. 丩 se lit jiū et ne donne plus le son de shōu. Saisir et rassembler : recevoir, ranger, récolter.
origine_en: The Shuowen jiezi glosses 收 as “to arrest, to seize”: 攴, the acting hand, and 丩 for the sound. 丩 is read jiū and no longer gives the sound of shōu. To seize and gather in: to receive, to put away, to harvest.
